deadline.value: Applications for fall 2027 admission are due December 1, 2026.
deadline.quote: Deadline for applications to the Biology PhD, MS, and MA Health Professions programs is December 1 of the year preceding admission.

app_fee.value: The biology page lists a $50 application fee; the Graduate School lists $60 for international applicants.
app_fee.quote: $50 application fee (can be submitted electronically with your application).

gre_general.value: GRE General scores may be submitted but are not required for admission.
gre_general.quote: Applicants may also submit official scores from the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) General Test, taken within the last five years, but it is not required for admission.

gre_subject.value: No subject test is mentioned for biology.

supervisor.value: EEO applicants are expected to contact faculty directly; CMHD students match with a mentor after first-year rotations.
supervisor.quote: It's critical for EEO applicants to contact faculty directly to express their interest in working with them.

funding.value: Assistantship funding is prioritized for PhD students and follows fall admission.
funding.quote: we prioritize assistantship funding for Ph.D. students.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's in biology is required, and an M.S. is preferred for PhD applicants.
entry_route.quote: Applicants accepted to our Ph.D. or Master-level programs possess at least a B.S. degree (M.S. preferred for Ph.D. degree applicants)

notes: The biology page says a CMHD track exists within the Biology PhD. That track was not mapped to the biomedical field, since Baylor has no separate biomedical PhD in the Graduate School table.
